description: Na₅Lu(SiO₃)₄ crystallizes in the trigonal R32 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.82 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.90 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.55 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.89 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.61 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.46 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. There are two inequivalent Lu sites. In the first Lu site, Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.28 Å. In the second Lu site, Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.24 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one LuO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-52°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.70 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LuO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LuO₆ octahedra, corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-50°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.70 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LuO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-50°. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Lu, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LuSi tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Lu, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LuSi tetrahedra. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Lu, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
